title: ר' שמעון בן זירוד

paragraphs: R' Shimon ben Zerud, whom R' Yohanan ordained. Puzzling—who told him this prophecy? Sanhedrin 14a says: R' Shimon ben Zerud and another with him, R' Yonatan ben Akhmai; one was ordained and one was not. See Rav Shemen bar Abba. See R' Yishmael ben Zerud; perhaps one is a scribal error.
